The Inklings

 In the Canvas experience, creation begins with the Inklings.

 They are playful hosts, threshold guides who live at the edge of imagination. Neither mascots nor characters, the Inklings appear as fragments of possibility — flickers of color, voice, or symbol that invite you to loosen, improvise, and play.

 Their role is simple:

 To welcome you into creation,

 To stir surprise and laughter,

 To seed symbols that will later matter.

 But once the doorway is crossed, the Inklings step aside. They do not follow you into Follow Me, where the work becomes vulnerable, nor into Echoform, where the archive deepens into continuity.

 The Inklings are not the story.  
 They are the spark at its beginning.
